listing.name: Missing Ships Mod
listing.summary: Adds 44 ships, 5 fighters, 6 weapons, and one mission, including specialized carriers, destroyers, frigates, and superlarge platforms.

description:
Updates might not be save compatible; there is usually a note in the changelog post whether it it isnt.

Click me

Hello.

These mods add a combined total of 44 ships 5 Fighters 6 weapons and one mission to your game. Noteable upcoming changes of any kind at the top of the Changelog.

Submods Contents

Contains functions:

-Combat readiness in seconds

-Carrier strike craft replacement progress visualizer

-Operations Center Audio (sub)Mod (WIP) (In development you have been warned)

Information in the Readme

[close]

Submods Contents

Capital ships

Paradigm

Midline Fast Battleship, with 3 large centerline mounts and a large missile hardpoint, very flexible. Improved PD armor and shields. Slower.

Spoiler

Paradigm Process 0.9.1-0.97[close]

Allegiant

Heavy Carrier. Focus on pilot survivability. High strike capability.

Chrysaor

Fleet Carrier, either with decend support weapons, pd or limited direct striking capability.

Cruisers

Scoophead

Large Hammerhead

Small Crafts

Claymore

A light corvette, with high range and good staying power.

Cutlass

DEM Strike Fighter.

[close]

Submods Contents

Capital Ships

Majestic Class

Capital Combat freighter made with of the shelf parts.

Cruisers

Gamble

Heavy escort cruiser, with slim support profile for traders and other independent fleets

Hawk

Training Carrier used in actual combat by traders or other independent fleets, slim support profile.

Destroyers

Nyx

Affordable destroyer escort, slim logistical profil.

Buffalo Mk3

A major conversion of the standard Buffalo-class freighter hull, the Mk.III sacrifices almost all of its cargo capacity in exchange for mounting twin Fighter Bays.

[close]

Submods Contents

Cruisers

Venture (A)

Fully Militarized.

Colossus (A)

Militarized.

Destroyers

Condor (A)

Slight adjustments.

Mule (A)

Slightly Uparmored.

Frigates

Mudskipper (A)

Militarized, wing carrier conversion.

Lasher (XIV)

XIV version of the Lasher

Small Crafts

Broadsword Mk.II

Broadsword, with two fighter swarmers added

[close]

Submods Contents

Capital Ships

Atlas Mk.IV

Artillery Ship to give larger path forces some punch (lower hullfrequency if there are to many)

Cruisers

Starliner Mk.III

Fast makeshift carrier.

Dominator (LP)

Fast Missile Cruiser.

Destroyers

Condor (LP)

Fast Carrier.

Mule (LP)

Frigates

Wolf (LP)

Convoy hunter, with stripped down technologie.

Mercury (LP)

Path supplyfleet runner. (Should only spawn in those).

Hermes (LP)

Path supplyfleet runner. (Should only spawn in those).

Mudskipper Mk.III

High speed missile boat. Naturally with build in hammers.

Small Crafts

Snake

Light Torpedo Corvette.

[close]

Submods Contents

Capital ships

Atlas Mk.III

Heavy carrier for pirates.

Cruisers

Starliner Mk.II

Reconnaissance and electronic warfare support carrier.

Destroyers

Nebula Mk.II

Electronic warfare support carrier.

[close]

Submods Contents

Large weapons

Atropos TVAT

First stage quickly adjusts heading second stage is a Atropost

Salamander Barrage

Fires a barrage of 6.

Heavy Graviton Beam

+10% overall Shield damage

Octuple Machine Gun

Low OP efficient machine gun cluster

Varunastra

Weapon changes damage type from HE to kinetic after halve the range has been crossed.

Medium weapons

Swarmer SRM Launcher

Medium swarmer

Mjolnir SB

Single barrel Mjolnir

Atropos Pod

Medium Atropos

Small weapons

Stub

Stub

Small Crafts

Assegai DEM Bomber

Fast, maneuverable, no shield, weak protection.

Ikakalaka Support Fighter

Slow, all offense support fighter.

Variants

Adds a small number of vanilla ship variants.

[close]

Submods Contents

Captials, Cruisers

Morion

Adds 5 Shield Depolying Drones that carry some point defense and can be arranged into different formations (blueish on hightech and redish on lowtech ships)

Captials, Cruisers, Destroyers

Jackrock

Adds 4 drones that aid with pd tasks (blueish on hightech and redish on lowtech ships)

Credit for this submod: Jamed Pake Dasi

[close]

Submods Contents

Management the Linked Module Targeting and the Spawning of platforms in factions explained in the readme.

Superlarge Vessels

Triumph

Midline Weapons Platform, carrying 3 long range dual gauss cannons and 2 lrm dem missiles tube arrays.  A rarely used system subjugator and symbol of domain power.

Spoiler

Progress up to 0.97a[close]

Crescendo

Midline strike platfrom, self explainatory. Boosted strike craft damage through shipsystem

Anchor

Exploration Vessel, originaly used for the rare occasion that a survey mothership and its drones found something of such note, that it had to be investigated befor the colonization fleets arrived.

Sovereign

Old Weapons Platform reportedly, used to intimidate newly accuired systems or, subjugate rebelling ones on occasion.

Ragnarok

A gargantuan platform with no clear manufacturer could be a modifyed mass coveyor of old.

Spoiler

The one below is Special Edition or circumstances only.

[close][close]

Submods ContentsShips that have been cut from MSM readded here for the sake of modularity.

Cruisers

Eagle (LP)

Falcon Path

Venture Path

Venture Pirate

Destroyers

Enforcer Path

Hammerhead Path

Tarsus Mk2

Nebula Mk2

Hogtarsus

Hedgehog

Frigates

Slasher

Slasher (H) (Will be removed fully after the next game update)

Small Crafts

Catalyst

Undraper

Tusk

Steward

Nail

[close]

Link to version 0.98a

Link to version 0.97a

Configuration of the supermods is described in the readme! For best results, befor updating fully remove the old mod version and keep it until basic functionality of the new version is confirmed!
Please consult guides or the modcreator in case of further questions! Me being abscent for some time does not mean things are free to take!

This Edition and the regular version can be run side by side!

Archaeon-Original-DESCRIPTION OF SHIPS:Broadsword Mk.II, Colossus, Condor, Mudskipper, Mule, Nagato, Nail, Nebula Mk.II, Starliner Mk.II, Venture, Pirate Venture

Click me

Mods Contents

Superlarge vessels

Atrocity

Output of a (hopefully) corrupted blueprint (possibly) from a different universe.[close]Credits:

JEENAH: Atrocity sprite[close]

Enjoy!
